code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]

    pairs = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
            if abs(dr) == abs(dc):
                pairs.append((abs(dr), r1, c1, r2, c2, 1 if dr * dc > 0 else -1))
    connector = None
    if pairs:
        _, r1, c1, r2, c2, slope = max(pairs)
        connector = (r1, c1, r2, c2, slope)
        dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
        dc = slope * dr
        r, c = r1, c1
        while True:
            out[r][c] = 1
            if (r, c) == (r2, c2):
                break
            r += dr
            c += dc

    if connector:
        r1, c1, r2, c2, slope = connector
        lo_r, hi_r = sorted((r1, r2))
        lo_c, hi_c = sorted((c1, c2))
        def on_connector(r, c):
            return lo_r <= r <= hi_r and lo_c <= c <= hi_c and (c-c1) == slope*(r-r1)
        expand_all = len(ones) == 2 and len(sixes) > 1
        for sr, sc in sixes:
            if expand_all or on_connector(sr, sc):
                # The 6 diagonal is perpendicular to the line joining the 1s.
                # Fill its complete in-bounds diagonal.
                d = 1 if slope == 1 else -1
                r, c = sr, sc
                while 0 <= r-d < h and 0 <= c+d < w:
                    r -= d
                    c += d
                while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
                    out[r][c] = 6
                    r += d
                    c -= d
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
